import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.miscmodels.ordinal_model import OrderedModel

ae = pd.read_csv('/workspace/TASK008_BCG-CORONA_AE.csv')
dm = pd.read_csv('/workspace/TASK008_BCG-CORONA_DM.csv')

covid_ae = ae[ae['AEPT'].str.contains('COVID', case=False, na=False)]

# Option 1: Only patients with COVID-19
max_sev_covid = covid_ae.dropna(subset=['AESEV']).groupby('USUBJID')['AESEV'].max().reset_index()
df1 = dm.merge(max_sev_covid, on='USUBJID', how='inner')

# Option 2: All patients (no Covid = 0)
max_sev_all = covid_ae.groupby('USUBJID')['AESEV'].max().reset_index()
df2 = dm.merge(max_sev_all, on='USUBJID', how='left')
# For those who had COVID but NaN severity, we should probably drop them if we want to model severity
df2 = df2[~((df2['AESEV'].isna()) & (df2['USUBJID'].isin(covid_ae['USUBJID'])))]
df2['AESEV'] = df2['AESEV'].fillna(0)

# Option 3: All AEs with COVID-19?
# df3 = covid_ae.dropna(subset=['AESEV']).merge(dm, on='USUBJID', how='inner')

for name, df in [("Only COVID-19 patients", df1), ("All patients (No Covid=0)", df2)]:
    try:
        print(f"--- {name} ---")
        df = df.copy()
        
        # Categorical variables
        # For statsmodels formula:
        # C(expect_interact, Treatment('No'))
        # C(patients_seen, Treatment('1-50'))
        # C(TRTGRP, Treatment('Placebo'))
        
        # Mapping to numerical for OrderedModel
        df['AESEV'] = df['AESEV'].astype(int)
        
        # We need to make sure the reference categories are standard.
        # Usually, first level alphabetically or specified. Let's let pandas dummy it, or use OrderedModel from statsmodels.
        df['expect_interact_cat'] = pd.Categorical(df['expect_interact'], categories=['No', 'Yes'])
        df['patients_seen_cat'] = pd.Categorical(df['patients_seen'], categories=['1-50', '51-100', '>100'])
        df['TRTGRP_cat'] = pd.Categorical(df['TRTGRP'], categories=['Placebo', 'BCG'])
        
        X = pd.get_dummies(df[['expect_interact_cat', 'patients_seen_cat', 'TRTGRP_cat']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
        y = df['AESEV']
        
        model = OrderedModel(y, X, distr='logit')
        res = model.fit(disp=False)
        print(res.summary())
        print("Odds Ratios:")
        print(np.exp(res.params[:X.shape[1]]))
    except Exception as e:
        print("Error:", e)

library(MASS)

# Read data
ae <- read.csv('/workspace/TASK008_BCG-CORONA_AE.csv')
dm <- read.csv('/workspace/TASK008_BCG-CORONA_DM.csv')

# Filter for COVID-19 AEs
covid_ae <- ae[grep("COVID", ae$AEPT, ignore.case=TRUE), ]

# Max severity per patient
max_sev <- aggregate(AESEV ~ USUBJID, data=covid_ae, max, na.rm=TRUE)

# Merge with DM
df_only_covid <- merge(dm, max_sev, by="USUBJID")
df_only_covid$AESEV <- factor(df_only_covid$AESEV, ordered=TRUE)
df_only_covid$expect_interact_cat <- factor(df_only_covid$expect_interact, levels=c("No", "Yes"))
df_only_covid$patients_seen_cat <- factor(df_only_covid$patients_seen, levels=c("1-50", "51-100", ">100"))
df_only_covid$TRTGRP_cat <- factor(df_only_covid$TRTGRP, levels=c("Placebo", "BCG"))

m1 <- polr(AESEV ~ expect_interact_cat + patients_seen_cat + TRTGRP_cat, data=df_only_covid, Hess=TRUE)
cat("--- Only COVID-19 patients ---\n")
print(summary(m1))
cat("Odds Ratios:\n")
print(exp(coef(m1)))

# All patients

# Patients who had COVID but no valid severity (so AESEV is NA after max, although na.rm=TRUE handles it, let's just make NA 0)
